name: Gobblegeist

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.summary: Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
traits.text: The gobblegeist provokes no Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Repelled by Stars
traits.summary: Can't willingly move to within 10 ft of a seven-pointed star drawn on a surface or woven from wicker.
traits.text: The gobblegeist can't willingly move to a space within 10 feet of a seven-pointed star drawn on a surface or woven from wicker.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two Beak attacks; one can be a Talons attack.
actions.text: The gobblegeist makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one of them with a Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.summary: +8, 1d8+5 Piercing plus 3d6 Necrotic; the target's Hit Point maximum drops by the Necrotic damage and the gobblegeist heals by the same.
actions.text: 9 (1d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by the Necrotic damage it took, and the gobblegeist regains that many Hit Points.

actions.name: Talons
actions.summary: +8, 2d8+5 Piercing; a Large or smaller target is Grappled in both talons (escape DC 15) and Restrained.
actions.text: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage. A Large or smaller target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from both talons, and is Restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Eye Beam
actions.summary: 120-ft line, 5 ft wide, DC 14 Dex save: 1d12 Psychic and Stunned until the start of its next turn.
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 6 (1d12) Psychic damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the gobblegeist's next turn.

summary: A huge one-eyed bird that stuns with a beam from its eye, drinks blood to heal and carries off victims in its talons; a seven-pointed star keeps it away.
